transcript.content: Hi, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?
Hello, Dr. Smith. I'm here today because I've been feeling persistently depressed and sad for about a month now. It just feels like this heavy, low mood won't go away.
Have you felt this way for most of the day, nearly every day, for longer than two years, or is this a more recent change?
No, it hasn't been going on for years like that. This is a much more recent change, and I've only been feeling this way for about a month now.
Did this low mood start shortly after a specific stressful life event?
No, I can't think of any specific stressful event that triggered this. It just seemed to start on its own, and this low mood has been persisting for about a month now.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in most activities you used to enjoy?

Yes, I really have. I've completely lost interest in the hobbies and activities I used to love, like gardening and reading. Even when I try to force myself to do them, I just don't feel any pleasure or satisfaction from them anymore.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?
No, I haven't really noticed any significant changes in my appetite or my weight recently. Everything seems to be pretty much the same as usual in that regard.
Have you had trouble sleeping, such as difficulty falling asleep, waking up too early, or sleeping too much?
No, I haven't really had any significant issues with my sleep. It has been relatively normal, and I've been sleeping about the same as usual.
Have you felt more tired than usual, or noticed a decrease in your energy level during the day?
No, I haven't really noticed feeling physically tired or having a decrease in my energy levels specifically. My energy seems to be pretty much the same as usual.
Have you had trouble concentrating or making decisions lately?
No, I haven't really noticed any major issues with concentrating or making decisions lately. My focus and decision-making seem to be pretty much the same as usual.
Have you been feeling excessive guilt, worthlessness, or thoughts that you're a burden to others?

Yes, I feel deeply worthless and constantly blame myself for things, even minor mistakes from my past. I carry this overwhelming sense of guilt all the time. It really makes me feel like I'm just a burden to everyone around me.
